headline: NBC News projects Democrats win control of both chambers. Senate: 54 Democrats, 44 Republicans, with Alaska (Peltola leads by 626) and Mississippi (Colom leads by 65) still uncalled. House: NBC has projected 242 Democratic seats to 150 Republican. Kansas's and Alaska's governor races remain uncalled; no new Senate or governor calls or newer counts were found in the 9:36 PM check.
